App Manual Source Log in (( • )) ROGERAI · American AI research + infrastructure Tune in to the world’s decentralized Models . Sovereign inference that runs on your hardware or someone else’s through a privatized network. RogerAI is two things. A network where people share specialized open AI models from their own computers and anyone can use them, per token or free. And a lab that trains specialized small Wave models and opens them to users to fine-tune for private use. One OpenAI-compatible local endpoint, on your own machine Routing, failover and metering across community and private hardware Signed receipts for what you paid Read the receipts → ROGERAI LABS THE WAVE SPECTRUM PICO ON AIR · NANO FIRE ON AIR FIG. 1 - TUNE IN roger is one small program. Open the Models directory → No live data loaded yet · prices appear only after a broker response tune the dial - browse every model & station → RATE live market , set by operators REPLY priced per token , in and out WALLET debited per request , per token §3 / COMPANY What RogerAI is. RogerAI is an AI company in Orange County, California. We design decentralized networks and the marketplace on them, and we pretrain our own models from scratch for machines and manufacturing. Our cloud is global. Our footprint is local. ROGER The network One OpenAI-compatible endpoint for developers and teams, answered by machines people share. Sharing a model never shares your files ( what a requester can reach → ). Open model and runtime work ships under its model license. The network and broker are source-visible under PolyForm Perimeter. The marketplace. Anyone can put a machine on the air and set a price per token, zero included. On a paid band the station keeps 90%. The 10% is what keeps it private and spread out: the upstream sees a station, never a person, every request gets a signed receipt, and a dropped machine fails over to the next. What you earn → Industrialized. Your own machines can form an Edge: a private group on your own network, with no Tower and no market in the way. One screen, in the terminal, the console and the app, shows every machine and its health. Alerts for heat, disk, power and a machine gone quiet reach you by webhook, Discord or Telegram. Wave models read what a plant already emits: Modbus, Sparkplug B, Prometheus. The Edge, in the manual → About the company Browse models Read the manual Install and evaluate PING RogerAI Labs · right-sized intelligence ROGERAI LABS · THE WAVE SPECTRUM Wave: small models for machines ON AIR Wave Pico runs free on the network today: 293M parameters, trained from scratch, small enough for a Raspberry Pi. Wave Nano, the next size up, is on the network too, with two fire adapters: a fire controller and fire vision, as specialized models. Nano is sized for an NVIDIA Jetson, a Mac mini or a Mac Studio. Small models for factories and other industrial sites. Our lab works on enabling open models to run on hardware from a Raspberry Pi up: NVIDIA Jetson, AMD and Apple machines too. Each job gets an adapter, a small add-on trained on your records and switched on per request. Custom tuning → When it releases, the license is intended to be permissive: local use will not require RogerAI or its broker, and optional network services use separate network terms. The Wave Spectrum → Full program status → §4 / ON SITE Your device, now a sensor. No box to buy. A computer the site already has, a Wave model, and a small adapter for one job that plugs in without changing the model. Install RogerAI. One command on a computer you already have: a laptop, a desktop, or the industrial PC on the floor. Pick a Wave model. Sized to the machine. Wave Pico, the smallest, is built for one machine’s telemetry. Pick an adapter. A small add-on for one job. The first, fire early warning, is in the lab . Telemetry drift needs no adapter: it is built into the base. Or we train the adapter on your records ( custom tuning ), served from our cloud on a private band only you can reach, or built to run on site, offline if you want. It hands anything it cannot vouch for to a person. It is advisory, beside the control system and never in it: it never moves a machine, and a person makes every call. Fire early warning in the lab An add-on for Wave Pico, built to read smoke chemistry and heat against a baseline and raise a warning that says why and how sure it is. Telemetry drift in the lab Not an add-on: built into the base model. It is designed to flag a reading drifting out of its normal band, with how sure it is. Your own planned An add-on trained on your own machines and your own normal days. You will be able to build one; the tooling is not built yet. Every lamp reads the same status file as every other page. A lamp turns red only when you can install that adapter on your own machine. See where it sits → The devices → §5 / THE TUNE Your choice: stay local, or reach a network. Your tools 127.0.0.1:4141 one address, one key, unchanged per token RogerAI routes, meters, signs the receipt A station someone's GPU, the strongest right now Another station someone's GPU, next strongest A Tower a relay somebody runs 1 Tune in The strongest station answers. You pay per token and get a signed receipt. 2 It fades That station goes off the air in the middle of your work. 3 Re-tuned The next one answers. Same address, same key. Nothing in your code changes. FIG. 4 - Your tools talk to one local address. RogerAI picks the strongest station, meters the tokens and signs the receipt. When a station fades, the next one answers at the same address. go on air Share a model Point RogerAI at your local backend (vLLM, llama.cpp, Ollama, LM Studio, Osaurus). Set a call-sign, a rate, and your hours. Flip the switch. You are on air. roger share qwen3.8-27b --rate 0.30 tune in Use a model Pick a band, set your margins (max price, min speed). RogerAI locks the strongest station and hands you a local OpenAI endpoint + key. When one fades, it re-tunes. roger use qwen3.8-27b --max-price 0.30 --min-tps 40 §6 / SPECIFICATIONS the whole instrument, one plate Protocol OpenAI-compatible drop-in Transport Outbound long-poll no inbound ports Endpoint 127.0.0.1 local, key-scoped Pricing Per token operator-set, from free, $/1M Settlement Wallet balance debited live Lineage ed25519 co-signed ◆ weights, shard, token Split 90 / 10 operator's favor Curated list + 10% » marked, split on the receipt Relay split 90 / 5 / 5 station / tower / platform Interfaces Terminal + browser one store, two windows Reach Only the model port no shell, no files, no context Platforms macOS · Linux · Windows Apple Silicon: MLX and GGUF Backends vLLM · llama.cpp · Ollama · LM Studio · Osaurus · LiteLLM · any OpenAI-compatible §7 / THE INDUSTRIAL SERIES We wrote the book on this. Then we wrote the next one. Two field books for people who own machines: what a small local model can honestly do on a plant floor, and the physics of running one on hardware you already paid for. Written by machines, put through the press's three-pass review, verified by Roger AI, and free to read in full. Published by o’ailly press , a machine-first imprint. Free models cost nothing. Custom tuning is priced on request. §9 / PRIVACY-FIRST AIRWAVES The provider hears a station. Never you. A callsign, not a name Whoever answers hears a callsign and a job. Not your name, not your card, not your IP. Nothing ever knocks Stations dial out. No open port, no inbound path, no door to knock on. The honest limit Your words still reach the machine that answers. Too much? A confidential station or your own Tower . Carry, don’t compute No GPU? A Tower relays sealed work and keeps 5% of everything it carries. Raise a Tower → The exit is built in Run it standalone : your own private network, free, and it never phones home. A network you can leave has to earn your staying. Sometimes, go direct Steady volume to one vendor is cheaper direct - do it. What you’d leave behind sits next to the prices → §10 / GO Start with one command. roger is one small program. It finds the models on your machine and connects you to everyone else’s . $ curl -fsSL https://rogerai.fm/install.sh | sh On Windows (PowerShell): irm https://rogerai.fm/install.ps1 | iex Then pick your window.
